class Solution:
    def getMaxTriples(self, n: int) -> int:
        a = [i*i-i+1 for i in range(1,n+1)]
        c = Counter(a)
        ans = 0
        if(c[0]%3 == 0):
            ans += c[0]*(c[0]-1)*(c[0]-2)//6
        if(c[1]%3 == 0 or c[2]%3 == 0):
            ans += c[1]*(c[1]-1)//2*c[2]
        if(c[0]//3%3 == 0):
            ans += c[0]*(c[0]-1)//2*c[2]
        
        return ans
